name: autolinkin
description: Turns shipped work into LinkedIn drafts you review before posting

drafts_dir.title: Drafts folder
drafts_dir.description: Where the linkedin-drafts folder lives (drafts, history, learned voice, state)

style_sources.title: Writing-style files (read only)
style_sources.description: Files that describe your writing style. autoLinkIN reads them and never edits them

protected_paths.title: Protected paths
protected_paths.description: Files or folders that need your approval, with the change shown, before anything edits them

display_name.title: Name on preview card
display_name.description: Shown on the LinkedIn feed-card preview

headline.title: Headline on preview card
headline.description: Shown under the name on the preview

stats_profile.title: Profile for account stats
stats_profile.description: Your main LinkedIn profile URL (for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/your-name/). Its followers, connections and recent posts feed the preview's insights
